Notices

  • A reservation can be made for up to 6 passengers per transaction, not limited to adults (over 16 years old) or children, and must contain at least 1 adult. The credit card holder must be one of the people listed in the reservation.
  • System will auto cancel waiting segments 36 hours prior to departure for long haul, and 28 hours prior to departure for short haul. If you still prefer to waitlist for award flights after previous mentioned time, please rebook waiting itineraries.
  • Reservations can be made from 3- 7 hours (depends on routes) to 360 days before departure. Online booking allows a round-trip, a one-way itinerary, an itinerary with different departure and arrival point but in the same country or round-trip with different booking classes.
  • If you are waiting for confirmation after booking an award ticket, please note that this system will not confirm the booking if you go ahead and issue the ticket. Contact your EVA Air reservations office for the latest booking status.
  • Passengers travel with infant(s), please issue your award ticket online before adding infant(s) into your Booking Reference Number; otherwise contact EVA Air Reservation center for assistance.
  • If your credit card transaction has been successfully authorized through Verified by Visa or MasterCard® SecureCode or American Express SafeKey® or JCB J/Secure, you will NOT be required to present the credit card upon check-in at the airport. In addition, the cardholder does NOT need to be one of the travel companions.(However, if you have only entered the 3- (or 4-) digit card verification code on the back (or front) of the credit card, then you will still be required to present your credit card at the airport.)
  • To refund award tickets, please click REFUND APPLICATION/ REFUND INQUIRY for online refund or you may contact EVA local ticketing counter.
    1. Refund service fee: For online refund, no refund service fee. For other channels, refund service fee US$50.00 will apply. The refund service fee will be waived for a member with Diamond, Gold or Silver tier at the time of application, please refer to Guidelines for EVA Air/UNI Air International Ticket Awards Redemption for more information.
    2. For entirely unused award ticket, EVA Air will refund applicable taxes, surcharges and miles upon request. Miles will be credited back to the member’s account if they are still valid on the refund date.
    3. For partially used award ticket, EVA Air will refund applicable taxes, surcharges and miles for unused flight segments upon request. Miles, after deducting the amount used according to one way award ticket requirement, will be credited back to the member’s account if they are still valid on the refund date.
  • Regardless of the place of issue, award tickets involving EVA Air/UNI Air international flights with journeys originating worldwide except Hong Kong will incur a booking service charge (YR tax code) per ticket. This fee is non-refundable upon ticket refund, regardless of whether the seat status is confirmed or waitlisted.
